Event Horizon (EH)

A niche term in some transcript-indexed ICT glossaries for a midpoint reference derived between two opening-gap structures, such as NDOG and NWOG. It is not a core, universal ICT definition.

Open interactive ICT Academy →Official ICT channel ↗Official playlists ↗

How to identify and use this concept

  1. Identify the two opening-gap structures required by the selected source.
  2. Calculate the midpoint using the source-defined boundaries.
  3. Record both gap boundaries and the arithmetic used.
  4. Test observed reactions separately; do not assume the midpoint is predictive or magnetic.
Use only as a documented derived reference when studying the relevant opening gaps.

Common mistakes and limitations

Inventing boundaries; mixing daily and weekly gaps; presenting one community term as universal ICT doctrine.

Evidence and source note

SUPPLEMENTAL · secondary terminology; definitions may vary · no audited strategy edge implied
